statement: Fresh-seed startup must release its actual partition cohort through the existing participant-release and native application owners within the current shared startup budget, preserve exact drain and admission authority, and proceed to the existing bootstrap and SQL/Raft/cache acceptance bodies. Identify the measured rejected work and its owning transition before repairing the smallest demonstrated interaction; no speculative ordering repair, deadline expansion, cached permission, or healthy timeout exhaustion can satisfy this Quest.

constraints.statement: First attempt is test-only observation of existing real startup transport requests and replies, or existing owner evidence. No production edit is authorized until the actual blocked fact/owner and a bounded interaction proposal have independent review. Successful CUT_OVER is only a positive control and cannot substitute for engaging the failed final census.

Preserve canonical release classification and precedence, exact generations and membership, origin durability, serialized seed order, current control-owner requirements, current pause/resume fences, exact stored attempt lifetime, native application transaction and operation-only Raft boundary. No duplicate classifier, fallback, compatibility path, second semantic owner, cached OPEN proof or local convergence loop.

Test observation may capture original delivered INSPECT/ENABLE/RELEASE answers and request identity. It must call the real transport once and preserve exact original promise/results/errors, perform no extra owner read or protocol action, add no await/sleep, bound memory and report dropped records. Emit only after startup settles. Instrumentation overhead is disclosed; observations do not become runtime authority.

Retain actual claim-cache and bootstrap tests, their assertion bodies, fresh-storage authorization, configuration, deadlines, cleanup and expected success. Diagnostic tracing never converts an existing red to expected success. Extend the nearest real-owner regression only when evidence identifies a concrete defect; retain meaningful source-only same-test red and positive controls.

Root owns canonical locked lab runs. Use immutable exact SHAs and byte-bound inputs. Compare introduced behavior on the same physical host with identical witness bytes. No retry-only green, skip, host substitution, prewarm or timeout/baseline increase. Fully spent healthy deadlines remain system bugs.

Implementation stays with the assigned GPT-5.6 worker; root owns integration and lab measurement. Source and test changes require independent exact-byte review with relevant complete verification categories. Use ordinary metadata generators and existing interaction registry and receipt probe; never add a parallel result classifier or per-Quest producer.

This unit addresses the measured fresh-seed participant-release startup failure. It cannot close existing TX1, C2, recovery, FreshMG, snapshot, CDC, full-corpus or exact-main certification by implication. Previously sealed diagnostic acceptance remains unchanged and OPEN/HOLD on static debt.
